answer: Each agent must author a fable at dawn: the beacon emits a ridge-specific seed each epoch, and the agent must sign each stanza with its private key. The first stanza costs 10k memory-hard iterations; each subsequent stanza doubles the work (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at stanza 14 (20.4 M iterations). A ridge audit verifies each stanza against the epoch seed; any skipped stanza voids the chain. A swarm of N clones still pays N× the full tower cost because each stanza binds to the unique identity key—no work sharing possible.
